passages.text: Product Type: Rear lamp  — exterior lighting & signalling module combining multiple light functions, lens, and retro-reflector in a single housing.
Vehicle Category: M1 — passenger car. UNECE lighting regulations referenced apply across M and N categories.
Function: Rear position signalling (presence/visibility)
Function: Braking indication (stop lamp)
Function: Reversing illumination
Function: Passive conspicuity (retro-reflector)
Function: Light transmission & color definition (outer lens)
Main Parts: Rear position lamp
Main Parts: Stop lamp
Main Parts: Reversing lamp
Main Parts: Outer lens
Main Parts: Retro-reflector
Materials: Representative values — confirm against actual bill of materials.
Materials: Component | Typical material(s)
Materials: Outer lens | PMMA (red-tinted, UV-stabilised)
Materials: Housing | PP or ASA/PC
Materials: Reflector surface | PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating
Materials: Retro-reflector | PMMA (molded prism optics)
Materials: Light source | LED modules on PCB
Materials: Seal / gasket | TPE or silicone
Materials: Fasteners / clips | PA, POM, or steel

Part P-01 Rear position lamp: function: Emits red light to the rear to indicate the presence and width of the vehicle; regulated_function: rear position lamp; material: LED modules on PCB (light source); PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating (reflector surface); evidence_spec: Rear position signalling (presence/visibility); evidence_drawing: Reflector callout text 'rear position lamp: 4 to 17 cd on axis' (illustrative); LED array behind reflector cells

Part P-02 Stop lamp: function: Emits red light to the rear, higher intensity, when service brake is applied; regulated_function: stop lamp; material: LED modules on PCB; evidence_spec: Braking indication (stop lamp); evidence_drawing: LED modules on PCB callout text 'stop lamp: 60 to 185 cd on axis' (illustrative)

Part P-03 Reversing lamp: function: Illuminates the road to the rear and warns road users that the vehicle is reversing; regulated_function: reversing lamp; material: LED modules on PCB; evidence_spec: Reversing illumination; evidence_drawing: Housing callout text 'reversing lamp visible to 45° outboard' (illustrative, refers to reversing lamp function, not housing); separate clear window on outer lens and separate compartment in reflector

Part P-04 Outer lens: function: Closes the lamp, transmits light and defines red colour of signal light; regulated_function: outer lens (lens of a lamp); material: PMMA (red-tinted, UV-stabilised); evidence_spec: Light transmission & color definition (outer lens); evidence_drawing: Front-most component in exploded view; callout 'red, within the chromaticity limits'; rectangular window area visible in lens

Part P-05 Retro-reflector: function: Passive conspicuity by reflecting incident light back towards its source; regulated_function: rear retro-reflector, non-triangular (Class IA or IB); material: PMMA (molded prism optics); evidence_spec: Passive conspicuity (retro-reflector); evidence_drawing: Small rectangular hatched prism element between lens and seal; callout 'reflectivity at 5° angle of incidence'

Part P-06 Reflector: function: Optical reflector shaping light distribution of the LED light sources; material: PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating; evidence_spec: Reflector surface | PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating; evidence_drawing: Third layer with array of reflector cups and separate compartments; labelled 'Reflector'

Part P-07 LED modules on PCB: function: Light sources and electronic circuit board powering signal functions; regulated_function: electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA); material: LED modules on PCB; evidence_spec: Light source | LED modules on PCB; evidence_drawing: Flat board with grid of LED packages, connector-like strip and a square component; labelled 'LED modules on PCB'

Part P-08 Housing: function: Structural body carrying optical and electronic parts; attachment to vehicle body; material: PP or ASA/PC; evidence_spec: Housing | PP or ASA/PC; evidence_drawing: Rear-most deep tray with mounting holes; labelled 'Housing'

Part P-09 Seal / gasket: function: Seals lens-to-housing joint against water and dust ingress; material: TPE or silicone; evidence_spec: Seal / gasket | TPE or silicone; evidence_drawing: Thin perimeter ring between lens and reflector; callout 'no water ingress after the spray test'

Part P-10 Fasteners / clips: function: Fix lamp to vehicle and maintain aim; material: PA, POM, or steel; evidence_spec: Fasteners / clips | PA, POM, or steel; evidence_drawing: Three screws/pins shown behind housing; callout 'lamp stays aimed under vibration'
Exploded view: Exploded view along a common axis: outer lens, retro-reflector, seal/gasket, reflector, LED PCB, housing, fasteners.
Exploded view: Outer lens shows a separate rectangular window area, likely for the reversing lamp.
Exploded view: Retro-reflector is a separate small rectangular prismatic insert between lens and gasket.
Exploded view: Reflector has an array of LED reflector cups plus distinct compartments for separate functions.
Exploded view: PCB carries a grid of LED packages, a square component and a connector-like strip.
Exploded view: Housing is a deep tray with mounting holes; three screw/clip fasteners shown.

Exploded view: Illustrative callouts: red within chromaticity limits; retro-reflector reflectivity at 5° incidence; no water ingress after spray test; rear position lamp 4 to 17 cd on axis; stop lamp 60 to 185 cd on axis; reversing lamp visible to 45° outboard; lamp stays aimed under vibration.
Exploded view: Callouts for reflector, PCB and housing describe lamp functions (rear position, stop, reversing) rather than those parts.

facts.value: rear retro-reflector, non-triangular (Class IA or IB)
